editorial.blurb: EEST Asian Bistro is a hidden gem serving generous portions of flavorful Chinese food at prices that feel too good to be true.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the orange chicken combo for $11—they fill your tray to the top with protein, rice, and sides; staff has orders ready ahead of time for smooth takeout.

topDishes.note: Flavorful and beloved, comes with generous portions and rice
Loaded with veggies, aromatic, and pairs well with their chile oil
Part of hearty combo meals perfect for leftovers
